purpose: Conservative official Sunday-Mass venue tranche collected in one batch from SSPX Germany, GB/Ireland, Switzerland and Australia/New Zealand/Pacific. Mass-time uncertainty shown explicitly. Not a complete worldwide provider census.

review_summary.exclusions: Other offices, weekday-only Mass houses, ambiguous public access, transient services, duplicate schools and institutions are omitted; current timetable links are not frozen clock-time assertions.
